title: CommandError
description:
The `error` payload of the `{"error": ...}` envelope on the `launcher` command port. Fulfils demand `platform-vault-20260930-contracts-d115-command-port`. Every code here is decided BEFORE a reservation is written: none starts a process and none reserves the key, except `command_key_conflict`, which leaves the existing reservation untouched.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `unknown_command` | 404 | `command` is not a name in the provider's owner-controlled allowlist (or is not listed at all). Nothing was started. Not retryable until the owner adds the command. |
| `command_refused` | 403 | The name is known but THIS request is refused: the entry is disabled, a parameter is not declared for it, or the caller is not enrolled. `reason` says which. Nothing was started. |
| `command_key_conflict` | 409 | `commandKey` is reserved with a different `requestHash`. The stored reservation is never overwritten; mint a new key for a different execution. |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | The body does not match `command.request`. |

`code` is a closed set here; a new code is an additive release. `retryable` is `true` only when resending the SAME key and body later could succeed without an owner action.

command.description: The command name the request asked for, echoed for the owner's log.

reason.description: Only with `command_refused`: why a known command was refused.

ownerAction.description: Plain-language action the owner must take (add the command to the allowlist, enable it), for the caller to show in its waiting view.
